summary: VISUAL POLISH regression pass — CRITICAL BUG FOUND. The Reanimated AnimatedPressable Card (Card with onPress) renders WITHOUT any of its styles on web: bg=rgba(0,0,0,0), padding=0px, boxShadow=none, border=0px, no color override. This is broken on every screen that uses pressable Cards (Home: operations-card / onboarding-card / live-map-card / clients-card / payroll-card; Profile: subscription-card / teams-card / manage-subscription; Work Hub job-card-*; etc.). Compare on Profile: Account Details (non-pressable Card) renders correctly with shadow+padding; Free Plan / Manage Teams (pressable Cards) render as bare rows.

react_native_issues.issue: Anti-pattern: `Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Pressable)` with a function-form `style={({pressed}) => [...]}` — Reanimated's animated wrapper does not propagate Pressable's function-form style, so all styles are dropped on web (and likely native too). Recommended fix: wrap a plain `Pressable` inside an `Animated.View entering={FadeIn}`, e.g. <Animated.View entering={FadeIn.duration(220)} testID={testID}><Pressable onPress={onPress} style={({pressed}) => [styles.card, shadows.card, pressed && styles.cardPressed, style]}>{children}</Pressable></Animated.View>. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/UI.tsx:13,67-74

RN-Web deprecation: `shadow*` style props deprecated, use `boxShadow` — these now come from somewhere other than theme.ts shadows (theme uses boxShadow on web). Likely a third-party component. Non-blocking.

action_items: FIX (HIGH PRIORITY) /app/frontend/src/components/UI.tsx Card onPress branch: replace AnimatedPressable+function-style with Animated.View entering={FadeIn} wrapping a plain Pressable that holds the function-form style. This will restore card background, padding, border, soft shadow, and pressed-scale across the entire app while preserving the FadeIn entrance.

After fix, re-verify on Home (operations-card dark navy, live-map-card sage, driver-card sageDeep), Profile (subscription-card, teams-card, manage-subscription), and Work Hub (job-card-*) — all should show the new soft shadow + 18px padding + border + correct backgroundColor override.
critical_code_review_comments: Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Pressable) silently drops the function-form style — never combine these. Always put the Animated.* component as the OUTER element for FadeIn entrance and keep Pressable inner with its function-style intact.
shadows.card has both `web: { boxShadow: ... }` and `default: { shadow*, elevation }` — fine, but make sure consumers don't also push deprecated `shadow*` props (origin of the console warning).
Card prop signature currently can't accept hitSlop/onPressIn/onPressOut — fine for current usage but worth noting if press-scale is added later via shared values.

rca_of_issue: Reanimated's `Animated.createAnimatedComponent(Pressable)` returns a wrapper that processes `style` as a static value (or animated value) and does not invoke function-form style props (which are a Pressable-specific feature: style={({pressed}) => ...}). Consequence: the entire returned style array — including the static styles.card (bg/padding/border), shadows.card (boxShadow on web), the runtime cardPressed scale, and the caller's `style` override (e.g. backgroundColor) — is silently dropped on web (and almost certainly native too). The only thing that still works is layout from intrinsic children and the FadeIn entering animation, which is why icons+text still render but with zero card chrome. Reproduction: log in as owner, open / (home), evaluate `getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="operations-card"]')).backgroundColor` → 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'. Mitigation (one-component change in /app/frontend/src/components/UI.tsx Card): keep Animated.View as the FadeIn host and put a plain Pressable inside as the press target — function-form style then works normally and styles.card + shadows.card + style override + pressed-scale all apply.
